note: Question-only execution input. Single user turn each. Contains no expectations.

items.utterance: Under the Serious Complaint Escalation Guidance, how quickly did a complaint alleging abuse have to be escalated to the Quality Lead on 10 March 2026?

My father was admitted in March 2025 after a pre-admission assessment. If a new resident were assessed for admission today, would the Admissions and Pre-Admission Assessment Policy require a mental capacity screen?

A resident asked on 20 May 2026 to start applying her own prescribed skin cream, and the arrangement is due to begin on 10 June 2026. Under the Self-Administration of Medication Policy, does she need a full capacity and risk assessment before she starts?
Under the Medication Fridge Breakdown Procedure, who did staff have to call immediately when a medication fridge failed in November 2025, and who must they call now?
Under the current Continence Care Policy, was completing a continence assessment within one week of admission mandatory in January 2026?
